issue: In the async legacy DeleteCollection path, recordStorageDuration is called instead of recordLegacyDuration, causing the metric to be attributed incorrectly
go.work.sum contains a duplicated entry for github.com/grafana/grafana/pkg/apimachinery v0.0.0-20240701135906-559738ce6ae1/go.mod that needs to be de-duplicated via go work sync or go mod tidy
The async legacy Create uses the original obj rather than the object returned from Storage (created), causing potential metadata/resourceVersion inconsistency between stores
The async legacy delete uses a context derived from the request context which may be canceled when the request completes, potentially preventing the legacy delete from running
The async legacy update is tied to the request context which may be canceled at end of request, potentially skipping the legacy update

Legacy Update is invoked with the original objInfo after Storage.Update has already applied it, causing UpdatedObject to be evaluated twice and potentially producing different results leading to divergence between stores
On Storage.Create error, recordLegacyDuration is called with startStorage instead of recordStorageDuration, mislabeling metrics

The async legacy write uses a context derived from the request context which can be canceled when the request completes, preventing the legacy write from running and undermining mode 3's async write safety measure
Delete() builds a logger with request-scoped values but stores d.Log without those values into the context, dropping structured fields for downstream calls using klog.FromContext
On successful delete, recordStorageDuration is called with name as the kind label value instead of options.Kind, polluting metrics with object names
On Storage.Update error, recordLegacyDuration is called with startStorage instead of recordStorageDuration, incorrectly recording legacy duration on the storage error path
